description.en:
Starts a function as a child coroutine of the current event, so several things can happen at once (a fade, a message, a character walking...).
It creates a thread from _func (newthread), with the function's environment bound to the locals of the current call, stores it in the next free slot of subev_ctx.c_coros, and runs it right away until its first suspend(). InitChildThread(n) must be called first to make n slots. RunChildThread() then wakes all child threads every frame until every one has finished.
There is no bounds check: adding more threads than InitChildThread made room for fails.
Function to run in parallel. It can use suspend() and the other waiting helpers.
Slot number of the new thread (0 for the first one).

examples.case: Three things at once in an event (real usage, from ev42010300.nut)
